top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access. The attackers were able to steal administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information from affected organizations.

top_stories.title: Attackers exploited Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw to access tenant data
top_stories.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in the Microsoft Entra Connect Health API to access tenant data, including technical contact email addresses and configuration details of affected Entra tenants. Microsoft Entra Connect Health is a cloud-based monitoring service for on-premises identity infrastructure, and Microsoft notified affected organizations of the breach.

top_stories.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
top_stories.summary: Security vendors are developing varying approaches to access control for AI agents, converging identity, runtime, and development controls. CISOs must evaluate differing vendor strategies for keeping AI agents constrained to their assigned tasks and permissions.

top_stories.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
top_stories.summary: Rackspace disclosed a breach of its Spot cloud platform in which attackers used compromised credentials to gain unauthorized access to customer Kubernetes clusters. The attackers were able to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets, highlighting credential compromise as the attack vector.

top_stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
top_stories.summary: A China-linked threat actor known as Armory Castle exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026. The flaw is an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service, allowing attackers to gain unauthorized admin access and steal data.

news.title: Google’s semantic governance policies can block an AI agent’s tool call before it runs
news.summary: Google has introduced semantic governance policies in Preview on the Gemini platform that evaluate and block AI agent tool calls before execution if they violate company rules or don't match user requests. The enforcement mechanism sits outside the agent at a checkpoint such as Agent Gateway, with permissions defining what actions an agent is allowed to take.

news.title: Entra Connect Health data exposure: what to do | Enzo Soler
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in the Entra Connect Health API to read tenant metadata including administrator and technical contact email addresses, tenant IDs, and license tiers. Microsoft patched the flaw server-side on November 19, with no customer-side action required to remediate the vulnerability itself.

news.title: Microsoft Debuts Offensive, Defensive Security Tools for the AI Era
news.summary: Microsoft announced new AI agent security tools and transparency standards at its Ignite technical conference. The tools are aimed at protecting enterprise systems in AI deployments, though the announcement is broadly focused on AI security rather than specifically on identity or access management capabilities.

news.title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
news.summary: NordPass published content advocating for centralized password management over spreadsheet-based credential tracking for IT administrators. The piece covers credential visibility, identifying weak or reused passwords, and secure sharing practices.

news.title: Scope down permissions of existing sessions using AWS STS GetScopedCredentials
news.summary: AWS has introduced a new Security Token Service (STS) API called GetScopedCredentials that allows developers to narrow down permissions of existing sessions rather than granting full session permissions. The API is specifically designed for AI agent architectures where sub-agents should only receive the minimum permissions needed for their specific tasks.

news.title: Stock Looks Fully Valued On New Onboarding Security Tie Up
news.summary: SailPoint is highlighted in a financial analysis examining whether its 25.2% return over the past year is supported by its cash flows. The article focuses on stock valuation and investor considerations around product partnerships and upcoming investor events.

news.title: jumpserver v5.2.0
news.summary: JumpServer has released version 5.2.0 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides DevOps and IT teams with secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.

news.title: Windows 11 passkey bug cries failure after successful sign-in
news.summary: Microsoft released an optional update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2 to fix a passkey authentication bug. The bug caused a misleading error message to appear on Android devices even after a passkey sign-in had completed successfully.

news.title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
news.summary: Microsoft released the KB5132057 November Windows 11 preview update containing 28 changes and fixes. The update includes improvements to Windows Hello among other non-IAM-focused changes.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.6
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.6 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: Anzeige: Microsoft Entra ID: Identitäten und Zugriffe sicher verwalten
news.summary: Microsoft Entra ID is being promoted through a workshop focused on identity management and access protection configuration. The workshop covers hybrid environment setup and security strategies for Entra ID deployments.

news.title: Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day Flaw Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
news.summary: Broadcom disclosed a critical zero-day vulnerability in VMware vCenter that allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication entirely. No workaround exists, and fixed versions have been released for all supported branches.

news.title: Your AWS Security, Identity, and Governance guide to re:Invent 2026
news.summary: AWS is promoting its Security, Identity, and Governance track at re:Invent 2026, scheduled for November 30 to December 4 in Las Vegas. The announcement highlights identity challenges related to AI agents as a key theme for the event's sessions.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports aliases to simplify workload configuration
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has added support for aliases, allowing administrators to assign human-readable names to trust anchors, profiles, and certificate revocation lists (CRLs). Workloads can now request temporary credentials using these alias names instead of ARNs, simplifying configuration and management.

news.title: Amazon Cognito now supports AWS Secrets Manager for app client secrets
news.summary: Amazon Cognito has added integration with AWS Secrets Manager, enabling user pool app client secrets to be stored and managed through Secrets Manager. This update affects authentication and access control workflows for applications, AI agents, and microservices built on Cognito.

news.title: Identity context is essential for exposure management: Tenable One adds ways to bring in identity security data
news.summary: Tenable One has expanded its exposure management platform to ingest identity findings from third-party sources. The update enables security teams to assess and prioritize identity-related exposures such as stale and overprivileged accounts alongside vulnerability and misconfiguration data.

news.title: Major Brazilian Signature Apps Enable RCE & Fraud
news.summary: Brazilian government-sanctioned authentication middleware applications used for legally binding document signing contain remote code execution vulnerabilities. The flaws affect signature apps that serve as authentication mechanisms for high-stakes legal documents in Brazil.

news.title: NIST Finalizes Post-Quantum Cryptography Guidance, GAO Offers a Reality Check
news.summary: NIST has finalized its post-quantum cryptography guidance, establishing standards for encryption that can withstand quantum computing attacks. A GAO report reveals that federal agencies are behind in implementing defenses against quantum threats that could compromise current encryption protecting sensitive data.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside patches from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.

news.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
news.summary: Microsoft released a patch update addressing more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software products. This exceeds the previous record of approximately 1,000 fixes issued in September, which was itself about ten times the typical monthly patch volume.
